en.bdb: The obedient person always in obedience

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hukamee ba(n)dhaa hoi kai saahib dhe hukamai vich rahanaa|

en.bdb: One should remain in the will of the Lord by becoming an obedient servant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸਭਨਾ ਆਵਟਣ ਹੈ ਸਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko sabhanaa aavaTan hai sahanaa|

en.bdb: All are in His will and all have to bear the heat of the divine order.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਲੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਵਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhil dhareeaau samaau kar garab gavai gareebee vahanaa|

en.bdb: Man should make his heart a river and let the water of humility flow into it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਣਿ ਬਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh kai saadhasa(n)gat si(n)ghaasan bahanaa|

en.bdb: Leaving the worldly activities one should sit on the throne of holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਭਉ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਏ ਗਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat livaleen hoi anabhau aghaR ghaRaae gahanaa|

en.bdb: Merging consciousness in the Word, one should get the ornament of fearlessness prepared.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਦਕ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਸਾਬਤਾ ਸਾਕਰੁ ਸੁਕਰਿ ਨ ਦੇਣਾ ਲਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sidhak sabooree saabataa saakar sukar na dhenaa lahanaa|

en.bdb: One should remain true in faith and contentment; the transaction of thankfulness should be kept to continue and one should remain away from worldly give and take.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਰਿ ਨ ਡੁਬਣੁ ਅਗਿ ਨ ਦਹਣਾ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit_en: neer na dduban ag na dhahanaa ||22||

en.bdb: Such a person neither drowns in water (of maya) nor gets burnt in the fire (of desire).
